div.h1: Booking your rentals, step by step
div.p: Pick your items and your date. We check stock, send your quote and take care of delivery.

a.data-ri-wa: Hi Rent It.BB, I'd like to book some rentals. My event date is: ...

div.h2: From your list to your event

div.p: Choose your event date in the shop and add the items you need. Most items show their price for a 24-hour rental.
Prefer to chat? WhatsApp us on 234-8230 with your list and event details.
We check that everything is free on your date, then send your quote for you to look over and approve. The delivery fee is added to the quote.
Once you approve the quote, a 50% deposit holds your items for your date. The deposit is non-refundable.
Pay the balance 5 days before your event. We bring everything to your venue and pick it up when your rental time is over.
Most items in the shop show their price, so you can plan before you ask. Your quote adds the delivery fee.

li.span: Pay a 50% deposit to hold your items. It is non-refundable.
Pay the rest of your order.
We bring your items to your venue. Your rental runs for up to 24 hours, from delivery to pick-up.

img.alt: Farm table dinner set by Rent It.BB with heliconia flowers

div.p: Our prices cover up to 24 hours, from delivery to pick-up. Need the items longer? Ask us and we’ll do our best to work something out.
We bring your rentals to you. Items can’t be collected from us at this time. There is a delivery fee, and it’s added to your quote.
If bad weather or something unexpected affects your event, talk to us and we’ll work with you. Deposits are non-refundable, whatever the reason.
Send your request as soon as you have your event details, so we can check that what you need is free on your date.
All prices are in Barbados dollars and cover a 24-hour rental. Ready-made packages are in the shop too.
Send us your date and guest count on WhatsApp and we’ll help you put your list together.
Start your list in the shop, or send us a message and we’ll take it from there.
